text:
maria: Heads-up — last night's nightly allocation run shows a small but consistent drift in the per-team GPU accumulator between 02:45-03:15 UTC. ~ $1.9k of spend moved from infra to platform teams after allocations were applied.

alex: :eyes: do we have the raw diff? which table / job produced it?

maria: billing.alloc_team_daily, run id run_2026_03_18_03. Comparing to run_2026_03_17_03. I pulled a quick delta: platform +$1,874, infra -$1,902, misc changes to sandbox. looks like rounding + small attribution flips.

billing-bot: Automated alert — allocation-run run_2026_03_18_03 completed (status: success). Rule-set version: v2.14.7 -> v2.14.8 (deployed 2026-03-18 01:50 UTC).

jordan: That new v2.14.8 included the "accumulator_threshold" change, right? PR #3421. I think the threshold went from 0.20 -> 0.15 for faster drain. Could cause borderline reassignments when multiple pools overlap.

alex: confirm. ran quick query: ``SELECT team, SUM(delta) as d FROM billing.alloc_deltas WHERE run_id IN ('run_2026_03_18_03') GROUP BY team ORDER BY d DESC;`` returning platform +1874, infra -1902, sandbox +28.

sre-liz: We saw autoscaler churn around 02:55 UTC (k8s cluster eu-west-1). Pod churn + prefix cache invalidation could combine w/ lowered threshold to move a few long-tail allocations.

maria: OK. Two immediate asks: 1) rollback accumulator_threshold to 0.20 for tonight's run; 2) run a backfill to reassign the affected window if rollback confirms root cause. Approvals?

sam: +1 on rollback for tonight. small variance, but we should keep invoices stable until we confirm.

jordan: I can revert the flag in config-store. Quick revert command: ``rcctl set billing.accumulator_threshold 0.20 --env production``. Will schedule at 22:45 UTC to hit the nightly window.

alex: I'll prepare a dry-run backfill script and run locally against the snapshot. Example dry-run SQL: ``WITH changes AS (SELECT * FROM billing.alloc_snapshot WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18 02:40' AND '2026-03-18 03:20') SELECT team, SUM(expected - actual) FROM changes GROUP BY team;`` Should take ~6m on the snapshot.

billing-bot: Note — backfill will alter cost attribution; if run, invoices for affected teams for 2026-03-18 will be marked as changed and a billing-adjustment ticket will be required.

maria: Good point. Jordan / Alex, if dry-run looks like it fixes the delta, please queue a manual backfill and create a ticket in Finance board with expected delta and approvers. Tagging @finance-team and @accounting.

jordan: Will do dry-run now and paste results here in ~10m.

(10 minutes later)

jordan: Dry-run finished. Output sample: ``platform: +1874.32, infra: -1902.10, sandbox: +27.78``. When I simulate revert (threshold 0.20) on the same snapshot, simulated deltas become platform +3.21, infra -2.98, sandbox -0.23 — basically neutral within rounding.

sam: That looks safe to backfill. What's runtime of backfill on prod data?

alex: Backfill script (id backfill_20260318_accum): estimated wall time 45m, will stream changes to billing.reassign_log. Command: ``python infra/tools/billing_backfill.py --start "2026-03-18T02:40Z" --end "2026-03-18T03:20Z" --dry-run false --run-id backfill_20260318_accum``

billing-bot: Reminder — running that backfill will increment invoice version for affected customers and send notifications (opt-in). Ops playbook: billing-backfill-v1.md

maria: Alex, please run the backfill after Jordan reverts the flag and we confirm tonight's run is clean. Also open ticket: Finance-4859 with summary, expected dollar deltas, list of customers impacted, and request for accounting signoff. Mark high priority.

alex: Ticket created: https://phabricator.internal/Finance-4859 — added snapshot, dry-run output, and proposed backfill command. Assigned to @maria and @accounting.

jordan: Revert scheduled at 22:45 UTC — I'll post completion.

sre-liz: After revert, I'll monitor prefix cache invalidation metrics and autoscaler churn for the 02:40-03:30 window tomorrow. If we still see drift, we'll escalate to runtime team.

maria: Thanks all. Summary action items: 1) jordan revert at 22:45 UTC, 2) alex run dry-run again on tonight's snapshot and, if clean, execute backfill, 3) alex/maria open Finance-4859 (done), 4) sre-liz monitor tomorrow. I'll follow up with accounting after backfill. :shipit:

sam: ping if you need finance to approve adjustments quickly — I'll be available after 09:00 PT tomorrow.

billing-bot: Allocation-run note: next nightly will use rule-set v2.14.7 if revert is successful.

maria: closing loop — will post final status in this thread after backfill finish. Thanks! :raised_hands:
